description_en: Queries the BGP configuration of an SCG5000 or SCG5000-5G device whose version is 3.4.2 or later and has OSPF enabled
description_zh: 获取SAG设备动态路由协议OSPF的配置，适用于设备类型为SCG5000或SCG5000-5G的智能接入网关实例，且设备版本为3.4.2及以上
kebab_example: aliyun smartag view-smart-access-gateway-ospf-route --sag-ins-id sag-3manef62evrfr60000 --sag-sn sagf4dk0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ViewSmartAccessGatewayOspfRoute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
parameters.name: sag_ins_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: sag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SAG instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the SAG instances that belong to another Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

false (default)
true
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询跨账号所属的智能接入网关实例。取值：

false（默认值）：否。

true：是
parameters.name: cross_account

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the SAG instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: resource_uid

AreaId.description_en: The ID of the OSPF area

AuthenticationType.description_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

NONE: Authentication is disabled.
CLEARTEXT: Plaintext authentication is used.
MD5: MD5 authentication is used
AuthenticationType.description_zh:
认证类型。取值：

NONE：不开启认证。

CLEARTEXT：采用明文认证。

MD5：采用MD5认证

DeadTime.description_en: The timeout period of connections between OSPF peers. Unit: seconds

HelloTime.description_en: The time interval at which Hello packets are sent. Unit: seconds
HelloTime.description_zh: 发送Hello报文的时间间隔。单位：秒

Md5KeyId.description_en: The ID of the MD5 key

RouterId.description_en: The ID of the router that has OSPF enabled

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the task was created. Unit: milliseconds.

The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the epoch time January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CreateTime.description_zh:
查询任务创建时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建查询任务时的总时长

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. A value of 200 indicates that the task is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码。200标识查询任务成功

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message. A value of Successful indicates that the task is successful
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 错误信息。Successful标识查询任务成功

State.description_en:
The status of the asynchronous task. Valid values:

Initialized: The query task is initialized.
Offline: The SAG device is disconnected from Alibaba Cloud and Alibaba Cloud has not assigned the query task to the SAG device. After the SAG device is connected to Alibaba Cloud, Alibaba Cloud assigns the query task to the SAG device.
Succeed: Alibaba Cloud has assigned the query task to the SAG device.
Processing: Alibaba Cloud is assigning the query task to the SAG device.
VersionNotSupport: The query task is not supported by the current version of the SAG device.
BuildRequestError: The query task is not supported by the controller of the SAG device.
HardwareError: Alibaba Cloud failed to assign the query task to the SAG device because the SAG device is faulty.
TaskNotExist: The query task does not exist.
OfflineNotConfiged: The SAG device is disconnected from Alibaba Cloud and Alibaba Cloud has not assigned the query task to the SAG device. Alibaba Cloud does not assign the query task to the SAG device even after the SAG device is connected to Alibaba Cloud
State.description_zh:
异步任务状态。取值：

Initialized：查询任务初始化。
Offline：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后会继续下发。
Succeed：查询任务下发成功。
Processing：查询任务下发中。
VersionNotSupport：智能接入网关设备当前版本不支持。
BuildRequestError：管控不支持。
HardwareError：由于设备原因查询任务下发失败。
TaskNotExist：查询任务不存在。
OfflineNotConfiged：智能接入网关设备离线未下发查询任务，智能接入网关设备上线后也不会下发
